name: Yongsun
source:
a divorced man. He is a security guard at a nearby factory and is clever and adaptable. He has 2 children working abroad. He once competed in the national Olympics. 

He has a brother on the other side of the nation whom he hasn't seen since they were children. Used to own a small local good shop.
